title.zh: 将达沃市布纳万区圣伊西德罗描笼涯利卡南小学的名称变更为Pablo Piatos, Sr.小学的法案
title.en: An Act Changing the Name of the Licanan Elementary School in Barangay San Isidro, Bunawan District, Davao City, to Pablo Piatos, Sr. Elementary School
title.orig: An Act Changing the Name of the Licanan Elementary School in Barangay San Isidro, Bunawan District, Davao City, to Pablo Piatos, Sr. Elementary School

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1994/ra_7697_1994.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The name of the Licanan Elementary School in Barangay San Isidro, Bunawan District, Davao City, is hereby changed to Pablo Piatos, Sr. Elementary School.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
